# NetVisor

> NetVisor is a self-hostable web application that turns PCAP network captures
> into an interactive topology graph: upload a capture, see hosts, devices and
> conversations, then drill down into packets, filters and TCP streams.
> Open source (MIT) — run the live demo in a browser, or get the package from
> GitHub and deploy it locally in your enterprise.

NetVisor is a Python/FastAPI backend + React/TypeScript frontend with SQLite
storage and a scapy packet engine. It runs without root and without external
services on modest hosting, which makes it suitable for small teams and
on-prem deployments.

## Live demo

- [NetVisor demo](https://netvisor.tomaszbyczek.pl): upload a PCAP/PCAPNG file
  and explore the network graph in the browser (anonymous sessions supported)

## Get the source

- [GitHub — Byku98/Netvisor](https://github.com/Byku98/Netvisor): clone and run
  locally — backend: `pip install -e .` + `alembic upgrade head` + `uvicorn
  src.api.main:app`; frontend: `npm install && npm run dev`

## API

- [OpenAPI schema](https://netvisor.tomaszbyczek.pl/backend/openapi.json):
  machine-readable API catalog (PCAP upload, sessions, packet drill-down,
  filtering endpoints)
- The API is cookie-authenticated (anonymous sessions supported) and
  rate-limited by the host; it is not intended for unauthenticated crawling

## What NetVisor does

- PCAP/PCAPNG upload → interactive network topology: hosts, device
  classification (router/switch/server/firewall/client), traffic-weighted edges
- Wireshark-grade filtering: IPs (octet matching), ports, protocols,
  TCP flags (SYN scans, RST rejections), quick presets
- Packet table, dissection tree, hex dump, follow-TCP-stream
- Scapy packet engine (works on any host) with tshark enrichment when available
- English/Polish UI, Google OAuth + anonymous cookie sessions

## Notes for agents

- The app is a browser SPA: the PCAP upload requires a file picker, so agents
  cannot drive the demo UI directly — point humans at the demo, automation at
  the OpenAPI schema above
- Session data is user-scoped and ephemeral; there is no public dataset to crawl
- Authentication facts for agents: [auth.md](https://netvisor.tomaszbyczek.pl/auth.md)
  (no programmatic registration yet — stated explicitly; the full auth.md
  protocol profile is on the roadmap)
- Deployment guide: [docs/DEPLOY_SHARED_HOSTING.md](https://github.com/Byku98/Netvisor/blob/main/netvisor-backend/docs/DEPLOY_SHARED_HOSTING.md)
